messages:
Sarah: FYI Polaris Health invoice INV-2026-0421 is still outstanding, hit 38 days overdue today. Customer emailed saying cashflow crunch, asked for a split-pay option.
Ellen: ugh, that acct has been slow since Jan. I had a call w/ their CFO 3/10 — they promised $20k by 3/20 and it never hit.
Sarah: attaching quick details: ```Invoice: INV-2026-0421
Customer: Polaris Health
Amount due: $78,450.00
Due date: 2026-02-15
Days overdue: 38
Last contact: 2026-03-10 - promised $20k by 3/20 (not received)
Link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0421```
Ellen: thanks. I can push a softer ask first — full hold + payment plan option. Any constraints from finance on >$50k splits?
Mike: we can do payment plans but anything >$50k needs director signoff (policy FYI). Also prefer ACH to avoid card fees.
Jordan: tagging legal-bot — do we have any clause that prevents splitting beyond 90 days for this contract?
legal-bot: quick note: Contract v3.1 section 6.2 allows payment plans up to 180 days with exec approval; preserves right to suspend services for nonpayment.
Sarah: customer proposed 6-month split: paying $13k/mo starting 4/1. They asked to keep services live during plan.
Ellen: if they do 6 months that's borderline. Is there precedent to require a partial up-front payment then installments?
Mike: yes — we typically ask for 25% upfront for >90-day plans. For $78.45k that'd be ~$19.6k upfront, then remainder over agreed term.
Sarah: I replied to Polaris asking if they can do $20k on ACH this week + 5 monthly installments. Waiting on confirmation.
Ellen: if they agree to $20k today we can avoid escalation. If not, recommend service suspend on 4/5 per dunning schedule.
Jordan: who's approving exec signoff if they insist on 6 months w/o 25%?
Mike: Director of Finance (Vikram) — needs an email with customer payment history + proposed schedule. I can prep the summary.
Ellen: I'll try to negotiate stronger up-front commitment. Sarah — loop in Vikram if customer counters.
Sarah: noted. alsoPayments-bot just posted ACH retry: "ACH retry failed for INV-2026-0421 on 2026-03-22" :frowning:
Ellen: ack. @Sarah can you send a one-line escalation to sales-sre and cc Vikram if they refuse? We should also flag risk for revenue recognition.
Sarah: will do. Drafting short note now, will paste here before sending.
Mike: if they sign up for plan we need a payment plan doc + e-signature. I'll attach template.
Sarah: DRAFT to send to Polaris: 
```
Hi Sam — thanks for the update. We can agree to a payment plan if Polaris can do $20,000 via ACH by 2026-03-26 and sign the payment plan for the remaining balance over 5 monthly installments starting 2026-04-01. Services will remain active while on plan. If the upfront payment is not received by 3/26, we will need to place the account on temporary hold per our collections policy and pursue the next escalation steps. Please confirm and provide ACH info.
Best, Sarah (Redwood Collections)
```
Ellen: looks good. Add a line about invoice number in subject and cc legal?
Sarah: added invoice in subject and cc'd legal for records. Sending now.
(20 minutes)
Polaris reply (forwarded by Sarah): "We can do $15k today and need 6 months. Our AR is delayed, 25% is impossible right now. Can you accept $15k now + 6 monthly payments?"
Ellen: :grimacing: they pushed back on the upfront.
Mike: if we accept $15k up front we take more credit risk. We'd want a shorter overall term or a guarantee. Director signoff required for >90 days or under-25% upfront.
Jordan: recommend we counter: $15k upfront plus 5 months. If they still push 6 months escalate to Vikram.
Sarah: sending counter now.
(1 hour later)
Sarah: Polaris accepted: $15k now via ACH and 5 monthly installments. They submitted ACH mandate. Customer requested no service interruption.
Ellen: OK good. Mike — can you get director signoff? This is >$50k total but meets 25%? Wait it's not 25% (15k is ~19%). So still short. Need Vikram to approve under-25% upfront.
Mike: pinging Vikram via email thread (will include payment history + payments link).
(15 min)
Mike: Vikram approved on email: allow plan with $15k upfront + 5 monthly payments, require customer agreement signed and ACH mandate on file, Redwood to suspend if any payment misses its due date.
Ellen: great. Sarah — please confirm payment posted and attach signed plan, then update CRM and set dunning to monitor.
Sarah: payment posted: ACH settled 2026-03-25 $15,000. Signed plan attached to CRM ticket #FIN-4829. Setting reminders and monitoring. :white_check_mark:
Ellen: thanks team. Closing loop — keep an eye for missed payments. If anything hits, escalate to Vikram and legal.
Mike: noted. I'll update the finance ledger and reverse any pending outage notices.
Sarah: thread closed for now.
